notes.title: Shogun Curse Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented Overcharged+ from being correctly played and that could cause the game to be unstable afterwards.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented Tempered Swing from being upgraded if it was originally automatically upgraded by the Jade Raven relic.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Blood Shogun's kamikaze attack to still be used after he died.
[*] Fixed some missing indicators that provided information about the Red Mistress mechanics. Also fixed an issue with one of her attack's damage previews.
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented the fight from ending if Oni Doll was activated at the same time the fight finished when the last enemies were killed by reflected damage.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented cards in hand from properly moving to their positions after drawing a card.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Might applied to the player to visually affect enemies' attack intentions.
[*] Fixed the interaction error between the Open Book relic, the Second Breakfast card, and the Azure Talisman relic, which resulted in losing AP.
[*] Achievements should now be tracked and completed more reliably.
[*] Fixed an interaction between Second Breakfast and Last Blood, where Second Breakfast would fail to activate when it was dealt into the hand by Last Blood.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented Sapphire Necklace from properly granting 1 AP in certain circumstances.
[*] Fixed a bug that made the self-applied poison from Grave Choice dodgeable.
[*] Added a tooltip explaining what the Blind effect does.
[*] All cards that create Stacking Bullets should now display the Stacking Bullet card when inspecting it.
[*] Resolution, volume settings, and other options should now be properly remembered after the game is closed.
[/list]

notes.title: Shogun Curse Patch v0.88
notes.notes:
[h1]v0.88  Patch Notes: [/h1]

- The game is now available in Spanish.
- Added camera movement before and after the fight.
- The Double Damage icon has been fixed.
- Tempered Swing should now display its upgrade level correctly while upgrading it.
- Hands Tied debuff should now expire after the intended duration.
- Self-inflicted damage from Blood Price no longer scales with Might.
- Relics that grant buffs when facing elites or bosses now work on the Final Boss.
- Poison should now correctly damage stunned enemies.
- Random crashes should occur less frequently.
- Starting relic from soul upgrades should no longer change or disappear upon reloading or changing camps.
- Bloodlust Veil should now work correctly.
- Card copied with Copycat should now keep all modifiers.
- Death Mark should now work correctly and no longer crash the game.
- Overcharged effect should now persist between turns.
- Hexed Stab ability can now be prevented by Blind.
- The Huntress' Grasp relic has been temporarily removed.
- Keyword descriptions should now properly display while in zoom mode.
- Fixed a bug that caused Bleeding stacks to not be properly displayed.

notes.title: SHOGUN PATCH v0.8
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=FPeU5oadKr8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]56 New Cards Added![/h2]
New cards have been added for both the Accursed Shogun and the Huntress. We heard your feedback and felt we needed to add more different play styles for both characters. The new cards added include new archetypes such as bleed and poison with smaller sets to help you in your adventure. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892393/2d312e00d9fcfac25425cb8a4b90439f88b8f9ac.png[/img]

[h2]Complete Art Rework[/h2]
UI, UX, VFX all things art have been revamped across the board.

[h2]Enemy Rework[/h2]
We felt the enemies were too stale. In the end, it became too much of the same thing and we wanted to completely rework that. We want to make you feel challenged. 
Enemies are more adaptive in how they battle you, rewarding players who know the enemy mechanics. This makes sure each run is completely different and a more unique experience. Bosses have also been reworked, with a new skills and interactions.  

[h2]Story Tutorial[/h2]
A tutorial has been added for when you first enter the game. We wanted to build out the lore of the characters while also providing a smooth entrance for new comers to Shogun Curse. Dialogue and interactions with certain characters have also been fleshed out to enhance the Shogun lore.

[h2]Sound Revamp[/h2]
Audio and sound needed a big rework! So we overhauled the entire system and made a big improvement to sound and music have been added! 

[h2]New Unlock System[/h2]
To ease progression in Shogun Curse, you can unlock new cards and relics simply by playing and progressing in the game. Each character also has character specific relics and involved additional deck balancing and changes. 

[h2]Corruption System[/h2]
Corruption system was completely revamped. Instead of a static progression, we have changed the buff and debuffs applied on each corruption level for both the players and enemies. Not for the faint hearted. It is extremely hard, you have been warned.  

[h2]Endless Mode[/h2]
Once you get to the end of the campaign run you will be offered the chance to keep playing to see how powerful you truly are. Did you really create the best deck? How far into the endless abyss can you go? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892393/76a8334ef9b4b3ba4dd090d3d9f7ae9d078228bd.png[/img]

We are actively looking for more feedback! Please join us in the Oh Baby Games discord here: [url=www.ohbabygames.com/discord-join] DISCORD [/url]

notes.title: v0.1580 patch notes
notes.notes:
[h1]v0.1580 patch notes:[/h1]

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
- Fixed a bug that caused the Double-Edged Sword passive damage to linger for a turn after the active was used.
- Fixed a bug that prevented the defence part of Balanced Strike from scaling with buffs and debuffs.
- Fixed a bug that caused Possessed Ammunition to not properly reduce the cost of other cards after using a Demonic Bullet.
- Fixed a bug that prevented Guiding Lamp from triggering in the first fight of a camp.
- Fixed a bug that caused Demonic Bullets consumed by All Out to not count towards effects that require Demonic Bullets to be consumed (e.g. The Best Defense, Possessed Ammunition).
- Fixed a bug that caused Last Will to trigger the turn it was played instead of in the next turn as its description stated.
- Fixed a bug that prevented the cost of Grand Blast+ from being properly reduced based on the player's Demonic Bullets.
- Fixed a bug that caused the damage displayed in enemies' intentions to be inaccurate.

[h2]QoL Improvements:[/h2]
- Added floating numbers to show the damage mitigated by Defence. 
- Confirmation is now required before terminating an ongoing game by starting a new one. Souls earned in said game should now be properly granted to the player.
- Cards that have an extra effect after meeting a condition should now be highlighted when they are empowered.
- A warning has been added indicating the player that save file may become corrupt if the game is closed during auto-save.

[h2]Balance Changes:[/h2]
- Critical Aim: Added a visual indicator when the player is under its effects.
- Prediction: Added the 'Vanish' keyword.
- Prediction+: Cost increased from 0 to 1.
- Possessed Ammunition: Added the 'Vanish' keyword. This card can now stack.
- Possessed Ammunition+: This card can now stack.
- Reflective Shield: Effect now lasts for the entire fight instead of just the current turn. Cost increased from 1 to 2. Added the 'Vanish' keyword. This card can now stack.
- Reflective Shield+: Effect now lasts for the entire fight instead of just the current turn. Cost increased from 0 to 1. Added the 'Vanish' keyword. This card can now stack.
- The Best Defence: Added the 'Vanish' keyword and a visual indicator when the player is under its effects. This card can now stack.
- The Best Defence+: Added the 'Vanish' keyword and a visual indicator when the player is under its effects. This card can now stack.

[h2]Map Rework:[/h2]
Several changes were made to the map screen to improve navigation and readability:
- Different nodes are now color-coded.
- The mouse wheel can now be used to scroll through the map.
- A marker indicating available nodes has been added.
- Paths that cannot be taken by the player are now grayed out.
- Icons indicating cleared nodes have been updated.
- Reduced overlap between nodes.
- Each camp now has its own color theme.
- Zoom is now locked and map sized was increased.

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.15
notes.notes:
v 0.1500 Patch notes:

[code]Fixed a visual bug that caused souls gained to be displayed incorrectly.
Fixed an error with Yigdra boss that caused the End Button to be unclickable.
Fixed an issue that caused damage dealt on enemies not being instantly updated.
Fixed an issue that made Ritual Earring count cards played more than once.
Fixed an issue that made enemies slain with area of effect cards count multiple times towards soul rewards.
Fixed an unwanted interaction between the Golden Bracelet relic and Hold cards.
Fixed an issue that caused unlocked difficulty levels to not be properly saved.

A counter indicating how many cards the players currently have in hand has been added.
The difficulty toggle has been removed. Now the player can select Level 0 to play the game's base difficulty.
A panel to keep track of the current run soul progress has been added.
Max hand size is now properly set to 10.

Smoke Grenade+: The visual indicator now displays the amount of attacks blinded correctly.
Added a new Area of Effect attack visual effect for the Huntress.
Enemies' health bars have been changed to further improve readability and also properly reflect the power level of each enemy.
Fonts have been further tweaked to make them easier to read.
Fixed a visual issue that caused the healing visual effect to be incorrectly played.

Unholy Grail: Health cost for playing cards up from two times the card's AP cost to five times the card's AP cost.
Ritual Earring: Card's needed for double cast increased from 6 to 10.
BronzeIncencer (Rework): Text now reads "Deal 6 damage for every 3 Vanished cards". Rarity lowered from Rare to Uncommon.
Prayer Beads: Damage preventing effect can only trigger twice per fight.
Grinning Armor: Rarity up from Uncommon to Rare. Shop price up from 230 to 255.
Magic Rope: Rarity up from Uncommon to Rare. Shop price up from 135 to 220.
Pestilent Claw: Temporarily removed from the game.

Demonic Shield: Cost down from 2 to 1. Defence down from 10 to 7.
Demonic Shield+: Cost down from 2 to 1. Defence down from 13 to 10.
Incapacitating Strike+: Added the Vanish keyword. Damage increased from 3 to 6.[/code]

[b]Difficulty scaling[/b]

The difficulty scaling curve has been changed. Early camps (specially the very first one) should be much easier, but each succesive camp will scale enemies' health and damage way more than before. This will allow an smoother and more natural curve. 
In addition to this, Combat afflictions (negative effects you get when beating a camp) now scale exponentially, depending of the order in which you clear camps:

Crimson Forest: Enemies gain 2/4/8/16 Might
Tani Town: The player gets 1/2/4/8 stacks of Impaired, Exposed and Brittle at the beginning of the fight
Rotten Swamp: The player gets 2/4/6/8 stacks of poison per turn 
Zen Desert: Enemies gain 5/10/20/40 Defense at the beginning of each turn.

Camp order should not only be about which camp is easier if cleared first, but also which camp is less harmful when cleared last.

We added an option to reset all your progress in case you want to experience the game as it currently is now. This will reset your difficulty levels unlocked, soul upgrades unlocked and souls gained. You can find this option in the settings menu accessible from the main menu.
